summary: Full backend + frontend E2E of MOD Automatic Quote Writer (CRM → Corporate → Quotes (CPQ) → MOD Auto Quote). All 10 pytest tests PASS. Frontend wizard executes Type A → Load Equipment → Review → Generate producing a quote (MOD-20260730-858D) with subtotal £1,057.52, VAT £211.50, total £1,269.02, contract-header £0 line and 8 auto-mapped machine lines; Type A also creates the MOD service contract (pending_activation, annual_value £1,057.52) returned by /api/crm/mod-quote/contracts. Type B path shows the UK Call-Out Charges field on step 3 and 3× £80 charges are added (no contract). Type C path enables per-line editable Unit £ inputs (no contract) and uses the custom price. Rate-card year-2 override (sor-2 → £60) flows through GET /equipment?year=2. Non-admin manager gets 403 on rate-card PUT. AI-match endpoint returns a rate_card_id via Emergent LLM. /api/crm/v2/quotes/{id}/pdf returns valid application/pdf (starts with %PDF). Quote also appears in /api/crm/v2/quotes list.
